seen_case_regression_suite.display_name: Seen-case fixture, contract, and evidence-boundary regression v1

checks: fixture identity, source and evidence provenance
model-visible input excludes labels and source/gate cues where required
response parsing, probe aggregation, and declared abstention invariants using deterministic test doubles
does_not_check: current provider/model predictions on all 36 cases
current-model gate accuracy, calibration, or generalization

regression_scope_audit.finding: The 36-case inventory is reproducible as fixture and contract/boundary checks, but the offline unit tests do not call the current model.
regression_scope_audit.test_evidence: The probe aggregation tests use deterministic test doubles; remaining checks validate fixture, provenance, prompt isolation, and response contracts.

event_scope_model_inference.root_cause: undetermined; one thinking-disabled controlled contrast returned a usable response
event_scope_model_inference.scope_note: v3 returned parseable JSON and its emitted quotes match the input, but offline qualitative comparison against AI-role-reviewed text labels found tree topology and scope mismatches. No quantitative score, human expert conclusion, or generalization claim is made.

next_controlled_attempt.reason: The single user-authorized controlled contrast is complete; no additional request is included in this baseline.

event_scope_model_inference.hierarchy_contract_note: Gate scopes are the sole hierarchy authority. Legacy parent_id is checked only as a derived projection; conflicts block the candidate and preserve the saved output. The prepared evaluation prompt was not run.

event_scope_model_v4.reason: The one parsed response has one hierarchy blocker: S2 contains only one direct child. Literal evidence locations are 9/9, which does not establish semantic entailment. All three emitted gate labels are unknown. This is one seen-Development qualitative observation, not a human-expert score or generalization result.

event_scope_prompt_v5.reason: The output places the cell-explosion and container-failure events under the top event in one scope, matching the intended local direction, but also emits four scopes with the same output, a single-child scope, and a missing required unknown_reason field on a known gate. The tree is not accepted or auto-repaired.

intended_offline_checks: maintain A and B as conditions associated with T without inferring an AND gate
use a single coherent hierarchy with one scope per output node and nested intermediate paths only when evidence supports them
avoid singleton gate scopes without inventing sibling nodes
require all gate fields and explicit JSON null for unknown_reason on known gates
keep model input label-free and validate the candidate structure without auto-repair
event_scope_prompt_v6.reason: One explicitly authorized request returned valid JSON; the hierarchy contract and all 10 evidence locations passed. Qualitative inspection identifies unresolved semantic issues, so the result is not accepted as a tree and makes no accuracy/generalization claim. Any further request requires fresh authorization.

event_scope_prompt_v7_candidate.reason: Offline tests cover evidence-binding instructions and label-free input only. The prompt has not been run against a model; any future live call needs fresh explicit user authorization.

event_scope_prompt_v8_candidate.reason: Offline tests verify prompt text, label-free input, and policy fixtures only. The prompt has not been run against a model; any future live call needs fresh explicit user authorization.

event_scope_semantic_smoke_v1.next_gate: retain SMOKE-005 as an expected-unknown gate observation with a structural blocker; do not retry; source-grounded semantic validation remains outstanding

candidate_fta_semantic_policy_v1.observation_policy: co-occurrence, simultaneous logging, sequence, or listing does not establish a causal edge or AND/OR membership; preserve evidenced disconnected nodes and block the whole candidate tree
candidate_fta_semantic_policy_v1.gate_policy: AND/OR may be inferred without literal operator tokens only when source semantics directly support joint necessity or independent alternative paths to the same output; otherwise unknown

candidate_fta_observation_boundary_v2.user_boundary: preserve evidenced observations as separate disconnected candidates; do not connect them to the top event or AND/OR without causal evidence

pre_fix_live_run.cause: relation_only remained only in the disposition ledger and the service early-returned before materializing disconnected observation nodes

review_scope_reconciliation_v1.rule: Review scopes use different populations and provenance; never sum them into one reviewed count.
